description: Get the user's meal plan from the Albert Heijn app's weekplanner, per day from today (about two weeks): planned Allerhande recipes, their own recipes, products and notes. Use the recipe_id of a planned Allerhande recipe with ah_get_recipe or ah_add_recipe_to_shopping_list, e.g. to shop for the week's dinners; the user's own recipes (own_recipe_id) can't be opened with those tools. incomplete=true means AH failed on some days or entries, so some may be missing or shown as type other. Planning recipes is done in the AH app. When you mention a product or recipe from the result, link its name to its url.

include_empty_days.description: Also list days with nothing planned (default false)

name: ah_get_meal_plan
title: Albert Heijn: Meal Plan
